phase2Deltas: Added explicit RPC DescriptorVersionV1 and made unversioned DescriptorVersion select current V2.
Added Sunder.Host.Contracts and Sunder.Package.Build to the existing .NET API baseline gate.
Aligned @sunder/sdk/browser resourceProfile declarations with the injected bridge object.
Replaced Runtime message-based RPC validation classification with structured validator metadata.
Applied duplicate-property rejection to Stack manifest and content-index metadata.
Added direct old/future schema rejection coverage.
Versioned the local Stack index and replaced silent corruption fallback with preserved explicit rejection.
Added explicit public/internal C# RPC binding accessibility with public compatibility defaults and fail-closed MSBuild validation.
Excluded generated XML documentation companions from public developer NuGets and runtime package payloads while retaining authored managed PDBs.
Removed the public Stack Worker registration convenience surface and the Sunder.Sdk.Stacks dependency on Sunder.Sdk.Worker.

allowedFutureDeltas.change: Replace RuntimeEndpointErrors Stack failure message matching with typed internal failure categories while retaining the reviewed public Runtime status/error-code inventory.
allowedFutureDeltas.expectedLedgerEffect: Runtime endpoint behavior is keyed by failure category rather than diagnostic text; no route, DTO, or public error-code addition.
allowedFutureDeltas.acceptance: Focused tests vary diagnostic text independently of category, every category maps to the reviewed status/code pair, and Runtime endpoint plus compatibility-candidate checks pass.

allowedFutureDeltas.change: Remove CreateWorkerProviderRegistration and the Sunder.Sdk.Worker project/package dependency from Sunder.Sdk.Stacks; construct Worker registration in first-party templates and consumers.
allowedFutureDeltas.expectedLedgerEffect: The Sunder.Sdk.Stacks public API baseline and NuGet dependency graph lose the Worker-specific surface; Stack format and RPC contracts remain unchanged.
allowedFutureDeltas.acceptance: Public API and packed NuGet dependency tests prove removal, templates and external consumers build, and App/Runtime receive no transitive Worker dependency through Stacks.
